--- create_model_array_of_struct_sized.sql
CREATE MODEL m
INPUT (x ARRAY<STRUCT<a STRING(MAX), b BYTES(10)>>)
OUTPUT (y INT64)
REMOTE

--- AST
&ast.CreateModel{
  Remote: 84,
  Name:   &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 13,
    NameEnd: 14,
    Name:    "m",
  },
  InputOutput: &ast.CreateModelInputOutput{
    Input:        15,
    Rparen:       82,
    InputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 22,
          NameEnd: 23,
          Name:    "x",
        },
        DataType: &ast.ArraySchemaType{
          Array:  24,
          Gt:     64,
          Rparen: -1,
          Item:   &ast.StructType{
            Struct: 30,
            Gt:     63,
            Fields: []*ast.StructField{
              &ast.StructField{
                Ident: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 37,
                  NameEnd: 38,
                  Name:    "a",
                },
                Type: &ast.SizedSchemaType{
                  NamePos: 39,
                  Rparen:  49,
                  Name:    "STRING",
                  Max:     true,
                },
              },
              &ast.StructField{
                Ident: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 52,
                  NameEnd: 53,
                  Name:    "b",
                },
                Type: &ast.SizedSchemaType{
                  NamePos: 54,
                  Rparen:  62,
                  Name:    "BYTES",
                  Size:    &ast.IntLiteral{
                    ValuePos: 60,
                    ValueEnd: 62,
                    Base:     10,
                    Value:    "10",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
    OutputColumns: []*ast.CreateModelColumn{
      &ast.CreateModelColumn{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 75,
          NameEnd: 76,
          Name:    "y",
        },
        DataType: &ast.ScalarSchemaType{
          NamePos: 77,
          Name:    "INT64",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE MODEL m INPUT (x ARRAY<STRUCT<a STRING(MAX), b BYTES(10)>>) OUTPUT (y INT64) REMOTE
